description: Adds native clipboard support to the CLI (the :clipboard_ex dependency, RGBA-to-PNG encoding in Tackle.CLI.ImageClipboard, Tackle.CLI.Clipboard.copy/1 behind the TUI copy notices); 4 independent bugs are seeded into lines it added.

edits.find: def copy(text) when is_binary(text), do: Clipboard.copy(text, timeout: @native_timeout)
edits.replace:
def copy(text) when is_binary(text) do
    Clipboard.copy(text, timeout: @native_timeout, terminal: :never)
  end

issues.description: read/1 collapses every Clipboard.read_image/0 failure into {:error, :no_image_in_clipboard}, so the composer cannot tell a broken clipboard (:clipboard_not_supported, :timeout, {:owner_exit, _}) from an empty one and silently pastes text instead of reporting the failure.

issues.anchor:
def copy(text) when is_binary(text) do
    Clipboard.copy(text, timeout: @native_timeout, terminal: :never)
issues.description: copy/1 passes terminal: :never, so the tmux/OSC 52 fallback its own moduledoc promises is never used: in a tmux, SSH or jailed session the text goes to the clipboard of the machine running the CLI and the documented {:ok, :requested} result is unreachable.

copy_notice/3 maps {:ok, :requested} (only the terminal was asked, so the copy is unconfirmed) to the plain success notice, contradicting its doc and telling the user a terminal-only copy definitely happened.
The new :clipboard_ex dependency is marked only: :dev although the app is listed in extra_applications and the CLI calls Clipboard.* at runtime, so the dependency is missing in test and prod builds.
